reviews.text: Ivan (AAAScreening) did a wonderful job on my patio.  The job was complicated due to a drainage issue on my property but Ivan and his crew solved the problem and gave me a beautiful extended patio that is draining perfectly and is absolutely beautiful!  His workmanship is superb. I highly recommend Ivan for any project involving patio enclosures.
reviews.author: Jean Reilly

reviews.text: Ivan did an excellent job on our screen room. He is very detailed orientated and cares about his work. Neighbors have commented on how nice it looks. It not only looks nice, it is a nice solid screen room. No leaks what so ever. I enjoy sitting outside covered from the rain and sun.
reviews.author: Suzanne La Plante

reviews.text: The project was left incomplete (2024). Ultimately, it became clear that the overall design was poorly conceived. It lacked proper planning and attention to detail, particularly regarding the cement patio and its drainage. Had these aspects been addressed beforehand, the result would have been far more functional and satisfactory, eliminating the need for another intervention.
reviews.author: PM Herrera

reviews.text: I was absolutely thrilled with his service! He took the time to explain everything that needed to be done, even going as far as to compare it to what his competitors offer. Additionally, he was very open about a necessary addition to the project that we hadn't anticipated. His team worked safely, even when unexpected rain storms hit. I can't speak highly enough of his company.
reviews.author: lori mein

reviews.text: AAA pro screening is a fabulous company. Ivan is honest and very talented. He does an excellent job and treats your job as if it were his property. He is efficient and trustworthy. He is punctual and my husband and I are completely satisfied with his work
reviews.author: Elaine Gerstein

reviews.text: Ivan did a really great job. He uses a lot of common sense along with his skills. He showed up on time and worked through the job, including the next day. I thought his prices were fair. He has done work for me before and it is quality and lasts a long time. His crew did a very neat and quick job of setting up and then taking away their tools. They cleaned up very nicely as well.
reviews.author: lisa richman

reviews.text: Ivan did a fantastic job in rebuilding my 20 year old Lanai structure and bringing it up to Code. It is sturdier than ever. He was meticulous in the details. The new supports and screens look great. He also kept his word and started and finished the job when he said. I highly recommend using AAA Pro Screening Inc.
reviews.author: Rita Gribben

reviews.text: AAA Pro Screening did an excellent job and they went on and above for customer care. I highly recommend them. Their workmanship  was outstanding.
reviews.author: Caryn Newborn
